title: 543 Faust Farm Road
summary: 25± acres of mixed timber with creek frontage and multiple homesites on Faust Farm Road in Crawford.
bullets: 25± acres located on Faust Farm Road in Crawford, Georgia
Mix of mature pine and hardwood timber throughout the property
Opportunity for a custom home, private retreat, or recreational property
Established driveway and internal road system
Conveniently located less than 30 minutes from Athens and Watkinsville
directions: From Downtown Athens, GA turn onto US-78E towards Crawford, GA. Continue for 14 miles until you reach Crawford. Then take a right onto Hutchins Road. Continue for 1.25 miles and turn right onto Faust Farm Road. Once on Faust Farm Road continue for 1 mile and the tract will be on your right.
